qa_pairs.question: What is the section number and title for this brake warning system diagram?
What fuse rating is specified for the power distribution box in the brake warning system?
What resistance value is shown for the brake sensor input?
What happens when the brake fluid level switch closes with low fluid?
qa_pairs.answer: The switch closes when sensor input is 9 volts with brake wear sensor open.

qa_pairs.question: What voltage specification is noted for the brake wear sensor connector?
qa_pairs.answer: Voltage at brake wear sensor connector is within 1 volt of battery voltage.

qa_pairs.question: Which indicators are shown in the gauges/indicators section of the diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: Charge indicator red, park brake indicator red, and brake fluid warning indicator red.

qa_pairs.question: What is the resistance value shown in the sensor circuit?
What ignition switch position is indicated as 'HOT IN RUN OR START'?
qa_pairs.answer: The power distribution box fuse 10 is hot in run or start position.
